'''Alland''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was situated on [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]].

==History==
Alland committed [[Alland Yards|its shipyards]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the defeat of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SoL" />
